import urllib.request
import re
import os

ABRAHAMIC_FILE = "abrahamic_corpus.txt"
OUTPUT_FILE = "shakespeare_corpus.txt"
TARGET_MULTIPLIER = 1.2

# Project Gutenberg IDs for Shakespeare works
SHAKESPEARE_IDS = [
    1513,   # Romeo and Juliet
    1514,   # Hamlet
    1515,   # Macbeth
    1516,   # Othello
    1517,   # A Midsummer Night's Dream
    1518,   # Merchant of Venice
    1519,   # Much Ado About Nothing
    1520,   # Twelfth Night
    1521,   # As You Like It
    1522,   # The Taming of the Shrew
    1523,   # The Tempest
    1524,   # King Lear
    1525,   # Henry V
    1526,   # Julius Caesar
    1527,   # Antony and Cleopatra
    1528,   # The Winter's Tale
    1529,   # Cymbeline
    1530,   # Troilus and Cressida
    1531,   # Measure for Measure
    1532,   # All's Well That Ends Well
    1533,   # Love's Labour's Lost
    1534,   # The Merry Wives of Windsor
    1535,   # A Comedy of Errors
    1536,   # Pericles
    1537,   # Coriolanus
    1538,   # Timon of Athens
    1539,   # Titus Andronicus
    1540,   # Two Gentlemen of Verona
    1541,   # Henry IV Part 1
    1542,   # Henry IV Part 2
    1543,   # Henry VI Part 1
    1544,   # Henry VI Part 2
    1545,   # Henry VI Part 3
    1546,   # Richard II
    1547,   # Richard III
    1548,   # Henry VIII
    1041,   # The Complete Works of Shakespeare (large omnibus)
]

GUTENBERG_HEADER = re.compile(
    r"\*\*\* START OF (THE|THIS) PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK .+? \*\*\*", re.IGNORECASE
)
GUTENBERG_FOOTER = re.compile(
    r"\*\*\* END OF (THE|THIS) PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK .+? \*\*\*", re.IGNORECASE
)


def strip_gutenberg_boilerplate(text: str) -> str:
    start_match = GUTENBERG_HEADER.search(text)
    if start_match:
        text = text[start_match.end():]
    end_match = GUTENBERG_FOOTER.search(text)
    if end_match:
        text = text[:end_match.start()]
    return text.strip()


def fetch(ebook_id: int) -> str | None:
    url = f"https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/{ebook_id}/pg{ebook_id}.txt"
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
        try:
            return raw.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            return raw.decode("latin-1")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"    [skip] {e}")
        return None


def main():
    abrahamic_size = os.path.getsize(ABRAHAMIC_FILE)
    target_bytes = int(abrahamic_size * TARGET_MULTIPLIER)
    print(f"Abrahamic corpus: {abrahamic_size:,} bytes")
    print(f"Target Shakespeare corpus: {target_bytes:,} bytes ({TARGET_MULTIPLIER}x)\n")

    parts = []
    total_chars = 0
    seen_titles = set()

    for ebook_id in SHAKESPEARE_IDS:
        if total_chars >= target_bytes:
            break

        url = f"https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/{ebook_id}/pg{ebook_id}.txt"
        print(f"Fetching ebook #{ebook_id} ...", end=" ", flush=True)
        raw_text = fetch(ebook_id)
        if raw_text is None:
            continue

        clean = strip_gutenberg_boilerplate(raw_text)

        # Extract title from first non-empty line of cleaned text
        title_line = next((l.strip() for l in clean.splitlines() if l.strip()), f"Ebook {ebook_id}")
        if title_line in seen_titles:
            print(f"duplicate, skipping.")
            continue
        seen_titles.add(title_line)

        header = f"{'=' * 72}\n{title_line}\n{'=' * 72}\n"
        entry = header + clean
        parts.append(entry)
        total_chars += len(entry.encode("utf-8"))
        print(f"done — {len(clean):,} chars | running total: {total_chars:,} bytes")

    corpus = "\n\n".join(parts)
    encoded = corpus.encode("utf-8")

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "wb") as f:
        f.write(encoded)

    print(f"\nFetched {len(parts)} works.")
    print(f"Wrote {len(encoded):,} bytes to {OUTPUT_FILE} (target was {target_bytes:,})")
    if len(encoded) >= target_bytes:
        print("Target reached.")
    else:
        print("WARNING: ran out of works before reaching target.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
